In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the autoencoder based multi-stream framework is a promising approach for improving the robustness of ASR systems.
our method outperforms the conventional sum and product rules in all the scenarios of mismatch between train/test conditions.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a novel approach for estimating confidence measures for multi-stream combination, and demonstrated its effectiveness on several speech recognition tasks.
the autoencoder based confidence measures can be used as an additional stream for multi-stream combination and can improve the ASR performance.
we have shown the use of autoencoders for estimating the robustness of each of the streams, which is used for combining posterior probabilities.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed autoencoder based approach for combining multiple streams is simple and computationally inexpensive.
autoencoders can be used as a tool for estimating the robustness of each stream, and hence for designing better techniques for posterior probability combination.
the autoencoder can be trained on features from a DNN, and can be used as a confidence measure for the corresponding stream.
